comment: The three ratchet subdivision switches carry no panel lettering; their names, Half Notes, Triplets and Quarter Notes, come from the maker's tooltips. Input 0 is left without a family because the position control switch changes it between a clock and a step-selecting voltage. The Set Scale list holds thirteen entries; the line names ten of them and None / Clear, because a spoken line cannot carry all thirteen. The three left out are Major Pentatonic, Minor Pentatonic, Blues and Chromatic. Diatonic is the one Accidentals Mode choice the module does not name for itself; it is named in the maker's manual alongside the other two.
